After the [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]], or ruler, of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] and the [[O'reenian]] people was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Rescue on O'reen|confrontation]] with the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]] and the [[Vornskr Company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> a war that began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a '''new Magnus''' was selected to rule the planet. This Magnus reacted to the events by advocating further isolation of the O'reenians from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="UR" />
